restaurantName: Lek Kee Authentic Teochew Braised Duck
address: People's Park Complex Food Centre, #01-1104, 32 New Market Road, 050032, Singapore
bio: There is always a queue at this stall, even before it opens. Their signature ducks are braised in a rich soy-based marinade with a hint of herbal fragrance. Braised pork skin and braised fried tofu are also unmissable. Pair with rice for a complete meal.
pageTitle: Lek Kee Authentic Teochew Braised Duck
